question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Get up on the wrong side of the bed

options.text: Someone who is having a horrible day
Someone who is having a good day
Go to bed or go to sleep

solution:
The correct answer is "**Someone who is having a horrible day**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The phrase** "get up on the wrong side of the bed"** is an idiomatic expression that means someone is in a bad mood or acting grumpy for no apparent reason. (किसी का मूड खराब है या वह बिना किसी स्पष्ट कारण के चिड़चिड़ा व्यवहार कर रहा है)

 
 
• **Example**: *She seemed to have **gotten up on the wrong side of the bed**__ this morning, snapping at everyone around her.*
 
 
 
• It suggests that a person's demeanor or disposition is negative or irritable from the moment they wake up.
 
• The phrase is often used humorously to explain someone's cranky behavior.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.
